rules.statement: A pre-emptive action can be brought against all co-owners in one action, even if the plaintiffs have different shares and are claiming relief alternatively.
rules.supporting_quote: "The order of the learned District Judge is therefore set aside and the case remitted to the lower Court for trial of the issues other than the 10th, 12th, 13th and 14th issues. The plaintiffs will be entitled to the costs of appeal and of the argument in the lower Court."
